description:
Veilink is the private AI network for job and business opportunities. Start in ChatGPT or Codex with your own words, a resume or a job description. You approve what Veilink saves.

Stop applying and keep your name and contact details private. Save a private profile and turn on matching when you're ready. Existing introductions continue if you pause new matches. Check your inbox for role terms and multiple-choice questions. You confirm each answer before the company sees it. Submitted answers are final.

Hiring teams compare de-identified profiles with role requirements. See what matches, what differs and what needs checking. You decide whom to approach and hire. After a hiring introduction is accepted, the company submits its contact details first. The job seeker reviews them and decides whether to share theirs.

For B2B, eligible companies verify a work email. Sellers list products or services. Buyers describe their needs and budget in a private brief and compare offerings. Only buyers can start an inquiry.

defaultPrompt: I'd like to build a profile for my next role. What should I share first?
Is there anything in my inbox that needs my attention?
Find de-identified candidates for our open role. What matches, what differs and what is still unclear?

publication.release_notes: Start a work profile with one question, keep skipped details optional, and pick up your draft after confirming pay or adding a major. See what needs your attention in the inbox, how pausing job matching affects ongoing introductions, and what happens to a request after a company edits its role. Eligible companies can also ask how to find suppliers.
